passwordHelp: Waiho kia wātea noa iho mō tētahi kupuhipa haumaru kua whakaputaina aunoa, ā, whakauru rānei 10+ ngā tohu me te kotahi pū me te kotahi tau.

versionAfterSignIn: Ka whakaaturia te putanga HAXcms me ngā ara tūmau katoa i te whakahaere pūnaha i muri i tō takiuru.
foreverTitle: Nōu tō HAX, mō ake tonu
foreverFiles: He kōnae noa ō pae i _sites, e aroturukihia ana mā git mai i te rā tuatahi.
foreverStandards: I hangaia ki runga i ngā paerewa tukutuku, nō reira ka mahi tonu āu mahi i te whakahoutanga o HAXcms.
foreverPortable: Kawea tētahi pae ki hea rānei: ka rere i runga i a HAXcms i te PHP, i te Node rānei, hei kōnae pūmau rānei.

installingHaxcms: E tāuta ana i a HAXcms
banner2: E AROWHAI ANA I TŌ TŪMAU
padNote: HAX Blocks i te hongere 2: whakataetae ki ngā hoariri e toru mō ngā paraka HAX. Ka hopu a A (ka pao rānei i tētahi hoariri i tō taha), ka whakahoki a B i tētahi, ka whakahou a Select i tō toa, ka whakaputa a Start. Ka mahi hoki tō papapātuhi: ka whakamārama ngā pere, a A me B i te pātene e pēhia ana.
tipDifferenceTitle: Te rerekētanga o HAX: ka mahi tonu āu mahi
tipDifference: He HTML paerewa tukutuku ō whārangi i roto i ngā kōnae noa nōu ake, e aroturukihia ana mā git. Tata ki ia pae i hangaia ki a HAX mai i te tau 2020 e mahi tonu ana i tēnei rā, ā, ka neke tētahi pae i waenga i a HAXcms i te PHP, i te Node, i te manaaki pūmau rānei, kāore he panoni. I hangaia kia mau roa, he māmā ki te ao.
tipFilesTitle: Kawea mai ō kōnae, ka huri ai hei HAX
tipFiles: I muri i te tāuta, mā te Kawemai i te papatohu e huri ēnei hei pae HAX ka taea e koe te whakatika, te whakahou, te kawe ki hea rānei.
tipSitesTitle: Nekehia mai he pae tukutuku katoa
tipSites: Tohua te Kawemai ki te wāhitau o tētahi pae, ā, ka uru mai ōna whārangi hei whārangi me ngā paraka HAX.
tipBooksTitle: Ka uru mai hoki ngā pukapuka me ngā tuhinga
tipBooks: Ka huri ngā pukapuka ako tuwhera me ngā pūtahi docs-as-code hei pae HAX, ā, ka mau tonu tō rātou hanganga.
tipPasswordTitle: Kotahi noa te whakaaturanga o tō kupuhipa
tipPassword: Ka whakaatu te hipanga whakamutunga i tō takiuru hou kotahi noa te wā. Tiakina ki tētahi kaiwhakahaere kupuhipa i mua i tō tīmata i a HAXcms.
